# Hauler: a boxy cargo ship that visits the pad (moved by the scene's game.as: one game bone). A cab
# with a glowing windscreen, a spine carrying a cargo pod, an engine block with two nozzles, four
# legs on foot pads. 2.3 m long, 1.2 m wide, 1.25 m tall. Up Z, nose to -Y; origin on the ground
# under its centre. Nozzles at (+-0.25, 1.2, 0.72): the jets attach there.
new
material new Hull --base-color 0.537 0.635 0.341 --no-slot
material new Cargo --base-color 0.302 0.502 0.380 --no-slot
material new Trim --base-color 0.188 0.365 0.259 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 0.745 0.863 0.498 --emission 0.745 0.863 0.498 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Cab --size 1 --location 0 -0.78 0.78
scale 0.9 0.62 0.62
apply --scale
apply --location
material assign Hull
active Cab
mode edit
select vert where "pos.y < -1.0 && pos.z > 0.9"
translate 0 0.16 0
mode object
add mesh cube --name Screen --size 1 --location 0 -1.06 0.9
scale 0.66 0.1 0.18
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name Spine --size 1 --location 0 0.15 0.62
scale 0.5 1.5 0.3
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Pod --size 1 --location 0 0.12 0.92
scale 1.2 0.92 0.66
apply --scale
material assign Cargo
add mesh cube --name Engine --size 1 --location 0 0.92 0.72
scale 0.9 0.4 0.5
apply --scale
material assign Hull
add mesh cylinder --name NozL --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.18 --location -0.25 1.13 0.72 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Trim
add mesh cylinder --name NozR --vertices 6 --radius 0.16 --depth 0.18 --location 0.25 1.13 0.72 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Leg0 --size 1 --location -0.48 -0.55 0.25
scale 0.13 0.13 0.42
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Leg1 --size 1 --location 0.48 -0.55 0.25
scale 0.13 0.13 0.42
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Leg2 --size 1 --location -0.48 0.7 0.25
scale 0.13 0.13 0.42
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Leg3 --size 1 --location 0.48 0.7 0.25
scale 0.13 0.13 0.42
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Foot0 --size 1 --location -0.48 -0.55 0.03
scale 0.28 0.28 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Foot1 --size 1 --location 0.48 -0.55 0.03
scale 0.28 0.28 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Foot2 --size 1 --location -0.48 0.7 0.03
scale 0.28 0.28 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Trim
add mesh cube --name Foot3 --size 1 --location 0.48 0.7 0.03
scale 0.28 0.28 0.06
apply --scale
material assign Trim
select all
shade flat
export hauler.glb
